import requests
from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis
from io import StringIO
from Bio import SeqIO

# 1. Fetch UniProt canonical sequences and masses
for acc, name in [("Q70EL3", "USP50"), ("P35237", "SERPINB6")]:
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    data = requests.get(url).json()
    seq_info = data.get("sequence", {})
    mass = seq_info.get("molWeight")
    length = seq_info.get("length")
    seq = seq_info.get("value")
    calc_mass = ProteinAnalysis(seq).molecular_weight()
    print(f"UniProt {name} ({acc}): length={length}, mass={mass} Da ({mass/1000:.2f} kDa), calc_mass={calc_mass:.2f} Da")

# 2. Check RefSeq sequences and masses
refseq_ids = ["NP_987093.1", "NP_004559.3", "NP_001131101.2", "NP_001131102.2"]
url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=protein&id={','.join(refseq_ids)}&rettype=fasta&retmode=text"
fasta_text = requests.get(url).text
print("\nRefSeq proteins:")
for record in SeqIO.parse(StringIO(fasta_text), "fasta"):
    mw = ProteinAnalysis(str(record.seq)).molecular_weight()
    print(f"{record.id}: length={len(record.seq)}, mass={mw:.2f} Da ({mw/1000:.2f} kDa)")
